entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Genoese navigator (1451–1506) whose 1492 transatlantic voyage under the Spanish Crown initiated sustained European contact with the Americas. His four voyages established colonial footholds in the Caribbean and unleashed the Columbian Exchange — the most consequential biological and cultural transfer in human history.
